title: SG-MMP: Reproducibility Package for Reasoning Fragility in Quantized Small Language Models
description: Source code and versioned evidence for the complete revision-full-v4 study of sensitivity-guided module-level mixed precision. Version 2.0.0 adds all-1,319-item GSM8K results across four models and three calibration seeds, matched-budget controls, the disclosed TaCQ shared-backend adaptation with contemporaneous SG-MMP controls, generation-integrity and Shadow-gate records, and a four-model GGUF/CUDA deployment-transfer extension with ten process blocks per model and method. The release includes frozen protocol, model and dataset manifests, per-run/sample records, checksums, and machine-readable analyses. Pretrained model weights, reconstructible quantized states, GGUF weight files, and dataset caches are not redistributed.
